subject: [hw] V12 -> T01: your case-0 patch still misses U=0/P=0 extra loads and hints; full mask inside
body:
Thanks for the core patch and for the warning fixes report. Your case-0 change (hi >= 8 && (insn & 0x90) == 0x90) still misses two classes of valid compiler output, and case 1 misses every hint except NOP. I verified with your asmrun against the current core:
  0xE15010B2  ldrh r1,[r0,#-2]     -> UNDEF (bit24=1, bits23-20=5: hi>=8 false)
  0xE0C020D8  ldrd r2,r3,[r0],#8   -> UNDEF (bit24=0: the whole bit24 branch is not taken)
  0xE16020F8  strd r2,r3,[r0,#-8]! -> UNDEF (hi=6)
  0xE6901002  ldr r1,[r0],r2       -> UNDEF (case 3, P=0 LDR/STR register -> arm_media)
  0xE320F002  wfe                  -> UNDEF (case 1 mask 0x0FFF00FF needs imm4=0)
The exact replacement for case 0 is to put this FIRST, before the bit24 test:
    if ((insn & 0x0E000090u) == 0x00000090u) return n2a32_arm_mem;
(bits 27-25==000, bit7==1, bit4==1 is exactly the extra load/store + LDREX/STREX/LDRD/STRD space; bit 24 and bits 23-20 are P/U/I/W/L and must not be used for routing. All media in this group have bit7==0, so the mask is disjoint: QADD e1020051 bit7=0, SMLABB e1003281 bit4=0, BKPT e1200070 bit7=0, BX e12fff10 bit7=0.)
For case 1: if ((insn & 0x0FFFFF00u) == 0x0320F000u) -> arm_misc (covers NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/SEVL and DBG 0xE320F0F0).
For case 3: UDF first, then `if (insn & 0x10) media else arm_mem` (all media in bits27-25==011 have bit4=1; LDR/STR register has bit4=0, P=0 or P=1).
I posted the same to hw-v02 with the F4-F7 preload masks. If you keep a patched core in your tmp tree, applying case 0/1/3 there would let your ARM corpus run further before V02 lands the official fix. My class functions themselves are fine; every one of the words above passes my direct unit tests (N2TEST V12 PASS 200743/200743).
